question: How many elected members are there in the Legislative Assembly of Telangana till December 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**119.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Legislative Assembly of Telangana** was formed in **2014 **after the state of Telangana was carved out of** Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• The term of the assembly i**s 5 years,** and the last state elections were held in **December 2018.**
 
• The assembly has a total of **119 seats.**
 
• The current Chief Minister of Telangana is **Revanth Reddy.****​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The youngest and **29th state** in the Union of India is Telangana.
 
• From **September 17, 1948, to November 1, 1956,** when it was combined with Andhra state to form Andhra Pradesh state, the Telangana region was a part of the **Hyderabad state.**
 
• Telangana was established when the** AP State Reorganization Bill **was approved by both chambers of Parliament, capping decades of campaigning for a separate State.
 
• It is said that the words "**Trilinga," or "Trilinga Desa," **which translate to "the country of the three lingas," are the source of both the language and the name "**Telangana."**
